description: This Go source file defines validation logic for required, optional, and forbidden tags in Kubernetes API code generation. It includes tag validation modes, validation functions, and handling of default values for fields.

classes.name: requirednessTagValidator
classes.description: Implements multiple modes of requiredness validation for Kubernetes API fields.

methods.name: TagName
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with the validator mode.

methods.name: ValidScopes
methods.description: Returns the valid scopes for the validator.

methods.name: GetValidations
methods.description: Generates validation functions based on the requiredness mode.

methods.name: doRequired
methods.description: Creates validation functions for required fields, considering the field type.

methods.name: doOptional
methods.description: Creates validation functions for optional fields, handling default values.

methods.name: hasZeroDefault
methods.description: Checks if a field has a default value and if it is the zero value.

methods.name: doForbidden
methods.description: Creates validation functions for forbidden fields.

methods.name: Docs
methods.description: Provides documentation for the validation tags.
